Gym Stone browser OCR dependencies (self-hosted)

Tesseract.js 7.0.0: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
Tesseract.js-core 7.0.0: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
English trained data: https://tessdata.projectnaptha.com/4.0.0/eng.traineddata.gz

The browser downloads these files from the same app origin. Screenshots are processed in the browser, with no image upload or external OCR request. English text is supported; users can correct or enter details manually for any screenshot.

Tesseract.js uses Apache License 2.0. See LICENSE.txt. Runtime files were downloaded from the version-pinned npm distributions. Original source and upstream documentation are linked above.
